events.did: 把铁锹扛在肩上，在半沉的旧坟之间穿行
events.quote_anchor: SYDNEY hoisted the shovels on her shoulder as she wove between the old, half-sunken graves.

events.did: 找到那座墓，墓碑上只刻着他的名字
events.quote_anchor: She found the right grave, the earth packed down by time, and cold. His name, and nothing more, carved into the headstone.

events.did: 把铁锹插进土里开始挖
events.quote_anchor: Syd drove the spade down into the soil and started digging.

events.did: 一个她加四个他一起挖到那只空木箱
events.quote_anchor: They worked together, one of her and four of him, making their way down to the empty wooden box.

events.did: 一个 Mitch 撬开空棺盖，另一个把 Victor 放进窄箱中
events.quote_anchor: One Mitch pried the lid off the empty coffin, while another lowered Victor down, settling his limbs inside the narrow box.

events.did: 握紧铁锹不放手，因为不信任自己的双手
events.quote_anchor: Syd stayed where she was, knuckles white on the shovel, because she didn’t trust her hands.

events.did: 差点爬进墓里把手按在 Victor 胸口把他拖回来，但最终没有
events.quote_anchor: Because, even now, she wanted to climb down into the grave, place her palms on Victor’s chest, and drag him back.
Because she understood, it was time to let him go.

relations.did: 告诉 Sydney 她不必来葬 Victor
relations.quote_anchor: Mitch had told her she didn’t have to come, but that was ridiculous.

relations.did: 曾发誓要在别人伤害 Sydney 之前先伤对方
relations.quote_anchor: Victor, vowing to hurt anyone before they could hurt her.

relations.did: 骗了她、离开她并伤了 Syd 的心
relations.quote_anchor: Victor, who lied, and left, and broke Syd’s heart.

relations.did: 回来了，哪怕这要了他的命
relations.quote_anchor: Victor, who came back, even though it killed him.

numbers.did: 过了“八年”仍认得回这里的路
numbers.quote_anchor: She knew where she was going, even after eight years.

numbers.did: 距离他们第一次把 Victor 从地下挖出来是“八年”，这次是把他放回去
numbers.quote_anchor: Eight years—that’s how long it had been, since the night they dug Victor up the first time, and now they were here to put him back.

numbers.did: 来了“两个”他，一起分担抬棺的重量
numbers.quote_anchor: Mitch walked in her wake—two of him, in fact, sharing the weight—Victor’s body wrapped in his black coat.

numbers.did: 一起干活时是“一个”她和“四个”他
numbers.quote_anchor: They worked together, one of her and four of him, making their way down to the empty wooden box.
